purpose: Examine decisions realistically supportable from the first video's 12 educational investment knowledge principles without a connected investor suitability dossier.

classifications.L1: Rules, risks, documentation requirements can be checked; personal outcome or tax figure not determined
classifications.L2: An explicitly labeled hypothetical numerical model or comparison can be executed; no personal strategy ranking
classifications.L3: Personal inputs and verified market/tax data would permit a conditional strategy recommendation; not demonstrated
classifications.L4: Ready for action or order/instruction; not demonstrated

test_cases.scenario: NPS top-up KRW18m vs invest same lump sum 12 years
test_cases.demo: KRW250k/month gain is unverified subscriber case: simple 72 months to nominal recoup after entitlement starts; alternative lump sum at hypothetical 4%/7% 12yr -> KRW28.819m / KRW40.539m
test_cases.missing: Personal NPS certified estimate and eligibility, post-tax benefit start age, survivorship, inflation, portfolio risk

test_cases.scenario: Immediate NPS at 65 vs defer full 5yr to 70
test_cases.demo: KRW1m/month vs KRW1.36m/month hypothetical; KRW60m forgone divided KRW360k extra per month -> 166.67 months after age 70, nominal break-even age ~83.89
test_cases.missing: Actual entitlement, net of tax/health/benefit interactions, discounting, survival, partial delay

test_cases.scenario: KRW800m balance, KRW4m per month, claimed 16yr tax-free and sustained distributions
test_cases.demo: 20yr*KRW750k/mo=180m; 4xKRW100m ISA rollover=400m; nominal input sum 580m vs 16yr withdrawals 768m. Constant net total annual returns -2/0/3/5% -> ~14.42/16.67/23.17/35.92 years of flat KRW4m nominal withdrawals. At deterministic 6% net and no fees, nominal flat balance can remain constant; not achievable guarantee.
test_cases.missing: Tax-excluded source ledger, tax credits, ISA transfer dates, actual fund costs, variable market returns, inflation, pension rules

test_cases.scenario: ETF general account vs ISA vs pension
test_cases.demo: Distinguish domestic equity index ETF sale gains and foreign underlying taxable listed ETF, pension investment-year vs withdrawal-year taxation
test_cases.missing: Specific ETF, NAV tax base, historical total returns and trading costs, account tax source and distribution

test_cases.scenario: Maintain older pension savings insurance vs tax-neutral account transfer vs terminate
test_cases.demo: Official consumer rules require separate transfer and surrender tax/guarantee checks
test_cases.missing: Actual contract min-guarantee, credited rate, charges, surrender/transfer values and investor risk

test_cases.scenario: ISA mature terminate/reopen vs extend vs transfer to pension
test_cases.demo: Hypothetical eligible net gain KRW6m; ordinary allowance 2m taxed 9.9% on excess -> KRW396k; qualified allowance 4m -> KRW198k. ISA rollover 10% up to KRW3m is additional deductible contribution base not automatic refund.
test_cases.missing: Eligibility, taxable instrument/loss type, account net P/L and rollover remaining capacity, tax-credit usage, transaction costs

controls: Source SRT not equivalent to confirmed video audio or visuals
Every numerical return example hypothetical and non-predictive
No original V3 or earlier V4 records overwritten
Real-world financial guidance requires client data and additional suitability/financial modeling checks
